update_contract.on_stage_start: Set exactly one active stage and preserve all later stages as locked.
update_contract.on_stage_fail: Record FAIL/BLOCKED evidence on the same node; do not activate another node.
update_contract.on_stage_pass_pushed: Record validation, exact touched paths, checkpoint document and source commit SHA; verify pushed main; only then unlock the next node.
update_contract.historical_evidence_rule: MCP/session/archive evidence may inform classification but cannot override current repository, machine-gate, runtime or exact Git evidence.
update_contract.ui_rule: Tree state mirrors plan/status data. UI state never becomes authority and never marks canonical PASS from narrative alone.
